notes.title: Bouncy Butter Ball - UPDATE v1.5.0
notes.content:
Hello!

We have some updates for you! This will make you get a better game experience, as we are currently working on version 1.5.0 of Bouncy Butter Ball. Here's a changelist:

Changelist:

[list]
    [*]Added several levels.
    [*]Added some decorations, the scene looks better now.
    [*]Adjust difficulty of some levels, make it easier for new players.
    [*]Adjust difficulty of some achievements.
[/list]

Of course, we will keep improving the game.
Please let us know if you experience any issues.

Enjoy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32799238/35a1e405702a4f2081622bbdd6daaed0bbd3eaca.gif[/img]
